plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Ume trees cover bare branches with fragrant blossoms while winter still lingers. The flowers are delicate, five-petaled and sweetly spiced. They are often the first sign that spring is on its way, and they perfume gardens and hillside orchards.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late January to March, usually peaking in mid to late February in warmer parts of Japan
plants.location: Japan, including Mito, Atami and the Kansai region
plants.funFact: Ume blooms weeks before cherry blossoms. In Japanese and Chinese culture it symbolizes perseverance, because it flowers in the cold.

plants.name: Protea cynaroides
plants.description: The king protea has the largest flower head in its genus. Its bowl of silky, pointed bracts surrounds a crown of fuzzy flowers. It is a bold, sculptural bloom on the fynbos hillsides of southern Africa.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mainly late winter to early summer in the Southern Hemisphere. In the Cape it flowers most heavily from spring into summer, with some blooms found in late summer.
plants.location: Western and Southern Cape, South Africa
plants.funFact: It is South Africa's national flower. It is also adapted to fire, because its thick underground stems let it resprout after bushfires.
